description: List the authenticated user's inbox: every non-archived conversation, both read and unread, newest first, returning each one's id, subject, last_message, last_message_at, message_count, and participants (id, name) — no message bodies; use get_conversation for the full thread. There is no scope filter here, so starred-only, archived, sent-only, or unread-only views aren't available. Fetches every page (100 per request) and fails with a 'Results are incomplete' error instead of silently truncating. Use get_conversation_unread_count for just the unread total instead of the whole inbox.
name: list_conversations
title: List Conversations
